They continue SA01's subjects: pinned realizations (SA01-1) in cotes 70, 78, 79; pseudolines (SA01-9, SA11) in cote 80; quadratic algebras (SA01-28, SA02-1) in cote 77; icosahedral groups (SA01-27) in cote 85.

Their "BT" label places them in the wrong cluster; their source is not identified (compare SA03-19, the operator-semigroup typescript of the same cote).
The package includes cote 161 (offprints on p-adic representations, Sen's theorem, the algebraic envelope). It belongs with the p-adic material, which the topic list does not name.
Good reduction of abelian varieties via Barsotti-Tate groups (cote 100) is the same programme as the BT crystals of cote 93.
